answer_4.quote: we validate the annotation crowdsourced in Section 3.2 by asking AMT workers to retrieve the correct target image from a set given its contextual description.
answer_4.guideline: For the final dataset, we retained only the examples that i) were retrieved successfully in the training set by a single worker or ii) were retrieved successfully by at least 2 out of 3 workers in the validation and test sets.
